info.title: Expensa API
info.description:
The HTTP contract of the Expensa backend.

Generated from the NestJS code at build time, committed as `backend/openapi.json`, and
the only source of the frontend response types in `frontend/src/types/api.d.ts`.
Do not edit either by hand: run `npm run api:sync` from the repo root.

message.description: String for most errors; an array for class-validator's field messages.

monthlyBudget.description:
Major units (e.g. 2000.50). Stored as integer cents. The cap is not a
product judgment: it keeps the cents conversion far inside JS safe-integer
range while staying generous for zero-decimal currencies, whose budgets
carry many digits.

monthStartDay.description: Capped at 28 so the day exists in every month.

categories.description:
The starter chips picked on screen 03, by name.

Required but allowed to be empty: A4 records that no minimum is enforced,
and a user who deselects everything is making a valid choice. Required
rather than optional so a frontend that stops sending the field fails
loudly instead of silently seeding nothing.
